cases.text: The incident was a single distinct event that delayed the train.
cases.basis: The complement repeats WordNet's defining nominal and identifies the cause of the delay.

cases.text: The incident was a public disturbance.
cases.basis: The complement repeats the competing definition. Its HAPPEN bank is open in release 014.

cases.text: The accident was a chance event that brought the ships into port together.
cases.basis: Chance event is an attested multiword lemma of this exact WordNet sense.

cases.text: The accident was a mishap that caused damage and injury.
cases.basis: The noun and elaboration match the unfortunate mishap definition. Its HAPPEN bank is open in release 014.

cases.text: The incident caused a public disturbance.
cases.basis: The result phrase names what the incident caused and supplies no definition of the incident itself.

cases.text: It was an accident that the woman fell and broke her arm.
cases.basis: The context permits both a chance occurrence and a mishap with injury.
